create_elastic_agent: create a SimpleElasticAgent with a WorkerSpec to manage distributed PyTorch workers
run_elastic_agent: run an ElasticAgent to start, monitor, and manage distributed worker processes with automatic restarts
rendezvous_workers: rendezvous worker groups to assign global ranks and configure distributed store addresses
monitor_workers: monitor worker group health and return run results indicating success, failure, or unhealthy states
assign_worker_ranks: assign global and role ranks to workers based on shared agent configuration in the rendezvous store
